audit.why: Poke-sustain vs engage lane difficulty (EVEN, 5.5/10) is already correctly captured; only pronouns and chart alignment needed fixing.
spikes[] correctly anchors level 2 poke, level 6 dueling ults, first item stun window, and late Tidal Wave disengage/W healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0,1,2,5,6].side all hold the templated 'Skill' while win[] already names Nami (0,1,2,6) or Braum (5) for those exact rows; the .why text on those rows was still the generic Braum-stacks-and-shields template instead of matching content's already-established verdict.
audit.why: Aqua Prison (Q, 12/11/10/9/8s CD) and Ebb and Flow poke let Nami out-trade Braum through level 3; Concussive Blows landing before her cooldowns return flips it at first item; her Tidal Wave disengage plus constant W healing reclaims it late.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2].side/why -> Nami; phases[5].side/why -> Braum; phases[6].side/why -> Nami. phases[3-4] already agree with win[]='Skill' and are left alone.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: Aqua Prison's bubble and Ebb and Flow poke out-trade your early presence.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: Her heal-and-empower pattern keeps Nami ahead in the poke war at level 2.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Her E on-hit slow and W sustain still out-value your walk-ups at level 3.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First item: Concussive Blows opens a stun-based all-in window for you.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Late, her Tidal Wave disengage and sustained W healing out-scale your single-target CC.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Locket or Zeke's line, Mobility-Mercs by lane, then Knight's Vow paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Commit on Aqua Prison’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. His answer goes first; yours goes last.
edits.after: Commit on Aqua Prison’s cooldown, on your first item spike, and with your carry’s damage online. Her answer goes first; yours goes last.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Land the fourth stack while Aqua Prison is down — that's the real green light, not the bait itself.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Raising Unbreakable after her bubble already lands only blocks the follow-up poke — face it before Aqua Prison, not after.

edits.before: - Nami Aqua Prison: matchup-defining — The bubble starts every Nami play — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. It writes your spacing rules. - E Unbreakable is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Nami's Aqua Prison (Q) is down 12s at rank 1, 8s late — sidestep it and her kit is small numbers. - Your Unbreakable (E, 16-8s CD) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R (130-100s CD) opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

notes: packet's defect note ('Braum wins 54.29% but chart gives Nami 4/7') is the same stage-vs-overall-winrate heuristic seen elsewhere and isn't a real contradiction — a champion can win most stages and still trail overall, or vice versa; content's win[] (Nami x4, Skill x2, Braum x1) is internally consistent with whys[] and was used as the source of truth. missingInteractions item on Nami's W sustain needing anti-heal timing is already covered in report[8].
